verdict.rationale: The Guichet unique is a hosted online service that stores filings and personal data, so data-residency choice is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence never mentions storage location, region selection or residency options. The only privacy-related item covers anonymizing filed documents and personal data, which is a different control and earns no credit here.
